text_block_list.text:
After school... Super Creek and Rice Shower
were in the classroom wearing costumes...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Dimming the lights in the dorms
really is dangerous after all, huh~? Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... Rice thinks... so too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai~ner♪
Rice-chan and I are on the committee for the "Inter-Dorm Test of Courage," so we're having a meeting right now~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now that the costume fitting is done, I'm brainstorming ideas for the test of courage, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Once you start thinking about it, it's really tricky.
Good ideas just aren't coming to me~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Rice might not be very good
at thinking about scary things..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's summarize all the ideas
we've come up with so far in the notebook.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? How strange~.
The mechanical pencil lead won't come out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-Then I'll take a note on my phone—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why?
It won't turn on...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Not again...!
Misfortune struck because of Rice again...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Creek-san...
Rice really shouldn't be on the courage test committee after all...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, please... Don't blame yourself.
Rice-chan, you didn't do anything wrong, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It's all... the work of ghosts!
Because you're dressed like a ghost,
they must have gathered thinking you're one of them."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a ghost...?
B-But... could something like that really...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look, again... I feel like
a ghost is getting closer~.
(Rustleee...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kya...! Something just touched my leg... A ghost...!?
In reality, Super Creek had merely stroked Rice Shower's leg with her tail, but—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Like a mischievous ghost.
Don't you think, Trainer?

It looks like playing up the ghost effect would be best.
Let's shake the desk from where Rice Shower can't see me...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eep! The desk!?
Wh-What should we do, Creek-san!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, rest assured.
I'll be sure to protect you nice and safe~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Spooky ghosts scaring Rice-chan!
Bad ghosties! Bad~~~!!"
(...*dead sileeeence*)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
……It got quiet.
A-Are the ghosts…… gone now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okaaay. Sent them packing, good and proper~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But what if they come back again...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll drive them away as many times as it takes,
and protect Rice-chan no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... let's do our best together
on the test of courage committee, Rice-chan♪
choice_data_list: In that case, that's a relief!
In that case, that's a relief!
If you're still scared, just lean on Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... let's do our best together
on the test of courage committee, Rice-chan♪
choice_data_list: In that case, that's a relief!
In that case, that's a relief!
If you're still scared, just lean on Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Leave it all to Mama~♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Rice is easily scared, and I don't know
if I can do a good job, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, to make it a fun test of courage...
I'll do my very best!”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, Rice-chan will be just fine. After all, she was able to overcome her fears♪
After that, a flurry of great ideas emerged, making the meeting a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, go ahead and spoil me all you want♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... T-To be honest, I'm still
a little scared... like...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, the~re, it's all right.
Mommy is right by your side~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, of course you can spoil yourself too,
Trainer-san, you know? After all, I am your Mommy♪"

And so, while Super Creek thoroughly
pampered everyone, the meeting for the test of courage continued.
